assets.name: Brom Van Brunt
assets.prompt:
Use case illustration-story. Generate an original high quality stop-motion needle-felt puppet character atlas for The Legend of Sleepy Hollow. A broad, sturdy adult man named Brom Van Brunt. Charming confident storyteller, approachable and humorous, not a villain. He has dark brown wavy hair, expressive crafted felt face, forest-green late-1700s long coat, brown waistcoat, tan knee breeches, black boots. Dimensional sculpted wool felt with visible fine fibers and elegant natural proportions, consistent with a handmade storybook miniature film. Soft even studio light, no harsh cast shadows.
A 1536x1024 transparent PNG sprite sheet with exactly 3 columns and 2 rows. Each equal 512x512 cell contains exactly one complete full-body pose of the SAME man. Consistent identity, attire, proportions and camera scale in every cell. Three-quarter front orientation toward viewer right. Full head and both boots always visible. All feet share a baseline 40 pixels above the bottom of their respective cell. Generous transparent margins and gutters, no arms or furniture overlap into adjacent cells. At least 35 pixels of margin around each figure and no cropping.
Poses reading order: (1) standing confidently with arms crossed and small smile; (2) standing storytelling with one arm extended toward the side, animated eyebrows; (3) a warm knowing laugh; (4) sitting relaxed on a small plain period wooden chair, chair completely visible and same ground baseline, same body scale as standing; (5) standing relaxed with one hand on hip; (6) standing with mildly skeptical raised eyebrow.
Actual transparent background alpha: no colored background, no gradient, no scenery, no ground surface, no floor shadows, no glows, no text, no labels, no borders, no grid lines, no watermark. Only the isolated puppets and one chair.
assets.processing: Unchanged byte-for-byte copy. PIL used only to read metadata.
assets.visual_review: Six full-body poses in a 3 by 2 atlas. Identity and costume consistent. Feet fully visible. Seated pose includes chair. No cross-cell overlap.

The same adult woman in each pose: sculpted needle-felt face, blonde single braid tied with blue ribbon, dark expressive eyes, kind amused expression. 1790s Hudson Valley costume: modest ankle-length burgundy dress, cream apron and white collar, brown boots fully visible. Bottom row poses: small graceful dance step with one foot visibly supporting her weight; attentive listening with clasped hands; doubtful raised eyebrow.
Each figure approximately 400 pixels tall, feet aligned near the bottom of its 512x512 cell. No figure or prop touches another cell or image edge. Every figure has complete head, hands, dress and boots. No background color, no gradient, no checkerboard, no lettering. This atlas will be used as individually cropped transparent animation sprites.
